bio_en: Ruben Ter-Stepanian was born on 10 November 1887 in Mezre near Kharpert into an old clerical family formerly called Bagratuni. He studied at the Sanasarian school in Karin until 1903, went to Constantinople after the 1908 constitution, and studied medicine in Marseille from 1909 and in Boston from late 1910. In 1915 he went to Vaspurakan, then worked in Tiflis, Ganja and from April 1917 in Etchmiadzin with the Union of Towns hospitals, serving among Andranik's soldiers in Nakhichevan. Settled in Tabriz as a beloved doctor, he died there of typhus on 5 June 1937.
